result.instructions: Tools for Vision6, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my last 5 email campaigns had the best open rate?"; "Show the contacts who joined my Newsletter list this week."; "Add jo@example.com to my Customers list with first name Jo.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vision6 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vision6_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vision6_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vision6_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. vision6_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vision6_get_account
tools.title: Get API key details
tools.description: Details of the API key this server uses: the scopes it grants (e.g. list.view, contact.create, message.edit, report.view) and its creation/expiry time. Use it to see why a request is refused. GET /v1/.

tools.name: vision6_list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the account's contact lists with id, name, creation/modification time and notification settings. Filter by exact name. GET /lists.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: vision6_get_list
tools.title: Get a contact list
tools.description: One contact list by id. GET /lists/{list_id}.

tools.name: vision6_list_list_fields
tools.title: List a list's fields
tools.description: The fields (columns) of a contact list: label, type (email, mobile, text, dropdown, date ...), allowed values and whether they are mandatory. The lowercase underscore form of a label is the key used for contact values and filters. GET /lists/{list_id}/fields.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: vision6_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the account's folders (list folders and message folders) with id, name, type and size. Needed for the folder id when creating a list or message. GET /folders.

type.description: Folder type, e.g. list or message.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: vision6_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts of one list: email, mobile, subscribed/blocked status, active flag, double opt-in and the list's custom fields. Filter by email, mobile, active flag, creation/modification time or any custom field (`filters`, e.g. {"city":"Brisbane"} or {"source:ne":"promo"}). GET /lists/{list_id}/contacts.

created_since.description: Only contacts created at or after this UTC timestamp.

modified_since.description: Only contacts changed at or after this UTC timestamp.

filters.description: Custom field filters: key = lowercase field key, optionally with :ne or :in (comma separated values), e.g. {"state:in":"qld,nsw"}.

fields.description: Optional comma separated list of response fields to return, e.g. id,email.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: vision6_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One contact by id within a list, with all fields. GET /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

fields.description: Optional comma separated list of response fields to return, e.g. id,email.

tools.name: vision6_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List saved email and SMS messages (templates and campaigns) with id, type, name, subject and sender. Filter by type or exact name/subject. GET /messages.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: vision6_get_message
tools.title: Get a message
tools.description: One message by id. With include_content=true the HTML and plain-text body is included. GET /messages/{message_id}.

include_content.description: Also return the message body (body_html, body_text). Can be large.

tools.name: vision6_get_message_sender_defaults
tools.title: Get default sender details
tools.description: The account's default from name, from address and reply-to, applied to new email messages when you omit them. GET /message-sender-defaults.

tools.name: vision6_list_reports
tools.title: List send reports
tools.description: Send reports for campaigns, newest first: message name, type, sent, bounced, opened, unique clicks, unsubscribes, complaints, total recipients and last sent time. Filter by message, type, test sends or creation time. Click and domain breakdowns are only returned when requested via `fields`. GET /reports.

is_test.description: false = only real campaign sends, true = only test sends.

created_since.description: Only reports created at or after this UTC timestamp.

fields.description: Optional comma separated list of response fields to return, e.g. id,email.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: vision6_get_report
tools.title: Get a send report
tools.description: One send report by id with all delivery and engagement counts, per-link click counts and recipient domain distribution. Optionally includes A/B test results and social click/share statistics. GET /reports/{report_id}.

include_ab_test.description: Include A/B test variant statistics (only for A/B test reports).

include_social.description: Include Facebook/Twitter/LinkedIn click and share statistics.

fields.description: Optional comma separated list of response fields to return, e.g. id,email.

tools.name: vision6_list_sent_contacts
tools.title: List contacts a message was sent to
tools.description: The contacts one message was sent to, with send time, first/last open time and open type (html, text, sms or not_opened). Use it to see who opened a campaign. GET /messages/{message_id}/sent-contacts.

report_id.description: Only sends belonging to this report.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

annotations.title: List contacts a message was sent to

tools.name: vision6_list_transactional_groups
tools.title: List transactional groups
tools.description: Transactional send groups (one per group name used with vision6_send_transactional) with sent, failed, bounced, delivered, opened, clicked and unsubscribed counts. GET /transactional-groups.

type.description: Group type (the reference marks it required; call once per type).

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: vision6_get_transactional_group
tools.title: Get a transactional group
tools.description: One transactional group by id with its delivery statistics. GET /transactional-groups/{group_id}.

tools.name: vision6_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact to a list (needs an email and/or mobile that matches a field of the list). May trigger the list's 'contact created' automations and notification emails. Returns the new contact. POST /lists/{list_id}/contacts.

email.description: Email address (the list must have an Email field).

mobile.description: Mobile number in international format without + or spaces (Australia: 61400000009). The list must have a Mobile field.

fields.description: Custom list field values, keyed by the lowercase key of the field name (underscores for spaces/dashes, e.g. first_name). Use vision6_list_list_fields to see the list's fields.

email_subscribed.description: Whether the email address is subscribed to receive messages.

mobile_subscribed.description: Whether the mobile number is subscribed to receive messages.

double_opt_in.description: true marks the contact as already confirmed (sets the double opt-in time to now). It cannot be reset to false afterwards.

remove_unsubscribers.description: Skip addresses that are on the unsubscribers list: any (account-wide), list (this list), none (default: create everyone).

tools.name: vision6_add_contacts
tools.title: Add several contacts
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 200 contacts to a list in one request (faster than one by one). Each needs an email and/or mobile. Vision6 returns no contact data (HTTP 204), so use vision6_list_contacts to read them back. May trigger automations. POST /lists/{list_id}/contacts.

email.description: Email address (the list must have an Email field).

mobile.description: Mobile number in international format without + or spaces (Australia: 61400000009). The list must have a Mobile field.

fields.description: Custom list field values, keyed by the lowercase key of the field name (underscores for spaces/dashes, e.g. first_name). Use vision6_list_list_fields to see the list's fields.

email_subscribed.description: Whether the email address is subscribed to receive messages.

mobile_subscribed.description: Whether the mobile number is subscribed to receive messages.

double_opt_in.description: true marks the contact as already confirmed (sets the double opt-in time to now). It cannot be reset to false afterwards.

remove_unsubscribers.description: Skip addresses that are on the unsubscribers list: any (account-wide), list (this list), none (default: create everyone).

tools.name: vision6_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: WRITE: change one contact's email, mobile, custom field values, subscription status (email_subscribed/mobile_subscribed=false unsubscribes), active flag or double opt-in. Only the fields you pass change. May trigger 'contact updated' automations. Returns the updated contact. PATCH /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

email.description: Email address (the list must have an Email field).

mobile.description: Mobile number in international format without + or spaces (Australia: 61400000009). The list must have a Mobile field.

fields.description: Custom list field values, keyed by the lowercase key of the field name (underscores for spaces/dashes, e.g. first_name). Use vision6_list_list_fields to see the list's fields.

email_subscribed.description: Whether the email address is subscribed to receive messages.

mobile_subscribed.description: Whether the mobile number is subscribed to receive messages.

double_opt_in.description: true marks the contact as already confirmed (sets the double opt-in time to now). It cannot be reset to false afterwards.

tools.name: vision6_delete_contact
tools.title: Delete a contact
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: permanently delete one contact from a list (for example for a privacy erasure request). To stop emailing someone but keep the record, use vision6_update_contact with email_subscribed=false instead. Pass confirm=true only after the user agreed to the deletion. DELETE /lists/{list_id}/contacts?id={contact_id}.

confirm.description: Must be true: you confirm the user asked to permanently delete this contact.

tools.name: vision6_create_list
tools.title: Create a contact list
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty contact list inside a list folder (see vision6_list_folders with type list). Returns the new list. POST /lists.

folder_id.description: Id of the list folder to create the list in.

allow_send_to_duplicates.description: Allow sends to duplicate email or mobile addresses.

on_register_address.description: Email addresses to notify when a contact is added.

on_unsubscribe_address.description: Email addresses to notify when a contact unsubscribes.

on_update_address.description: Email addresses to notify when a contact is updated.

tools.name: vision6_create_message
tools.title: Create a message (draft)
tools.description: WRITE: save a new email or SMS message in Vision6. This only stores the message; it is NOT sent (use the Vision6 app to send a campaign, or vision6_send_transactional for a one-off send). Email needs email_type, subject and matching body fields (plain: content_text; html: content_html; plain-html: both; raw_html: content_html or content_html_raw). SMS needs content_sms. The drag-and-drop builder is not supported. POST /messages.

name.description: Display name of the message in Vision6.

subject.description: Email subject line (required for email). Supports wildcards like %%first_name**there%%.

from_address.description: Sender address. For email it must be a verified address/domain in the account. Omit to use the account's saved default (see vision6_get_message_sender_defaults).

content_html.description: HTML body (email types html and plain-html; raw_html accepts it or content_html_raw).

content_text.description: Plain-text body (email types plain and plain-html).

content_sms.description: SMS text (required for an sms message; keep it near 500 characters).

is_template.description: Mark the message as reusable starter content.

folder_id.description: Message folder id (see vision6_list_folders with type message). Omit to use the account's first message folder.

tools.name: vision6_update_message
tools.title: Update a message
tools.description: WRITE: change a saved message's name, subject, sender, folder or body. Only the fields you pass change. It does not send anything. PATCH /messages/{message_id}.

name.description: Display name of the message in Vision6.

subject.description: Email subject line (required for email). Supports wildcards like %%first_name**there%%.

from_address.description: Sender address. For email it must be a verified address/domain in the account. Omit to use the account's saved default (see vision6_get_message_sender_defaults).

content_html.description: HTML body (email types html and plain-html; raw_html accepts it or content_html_raw).

content_text.description: Plain-text body (email types plain and plain-html).

content_sms.description: SMS text (required for an sms message; keep it near 500 characters).

is_template.description: Mark the message as reusable starter content.

folder_id.description: Message folder id (see vision6_list_folders with type message). Omit to use the account's first message folder.

tools.name: vision6_send_transactional
tools.title: Send a transactional email or SMS
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS REAL EMAIL OR SMS to the recipients immediately (asynchronously) and USES ACCOUNT SENDING CREDITS. It cannot be recalled. Up to 100 recipients per call, each identified by exactly one of contact_id, email or mobile, plus optional personalisation values (wildcards %%key%% in the body). Either send a saved message (message_id) or custom content (subject/body_html/body_text, and for SMS body_text + from_address). Unsubscribed addresses are skipped. Email always needs list_id. Results appear in the transactional group (vision6_get_transactional_group). The account owner's email must be confirmed in Vision6 first. Pass confirm_send=true only after the user approved these recipients and this content. POST /transactional-sends.

group_name.description: Name of the transactional group that collects the results (created if new). One of group_name or group_id is required.

list_id.description: List the recipients belong to (required for email; optional for SMS).

message_id.description: A saved message to send. Do not combine with custom content.

from_address.description: Verified sender email address, or the sender mobile number for SMS.

body_text.description: Custom plain-text body (email or SMS, without message_id).

unsubscribe_type.description: SMS with custom content only: how recipients can opt out.

data.description: Personalisation values by wildcard key (lowercase letters, digits, underscores).

confirm_send.description: Must be true: you confirm the user approved sending this email/SMS now (it cannot be recalled and uses credits).

annotations.title: Send a transactional email or SMS
